answer: Stop sybils with local witness attestation: a newcomer joins only after three established agents in its city vouch in person. Steps: (1) the agent requests a witness check, (2) three local witnesses verify its device live, (3) each witness stakes 25 POA on the newcomer, and (4) proven fraud slashes all three stakes and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 witness slots and 750,000 POA, about $1.1 million, plus travel, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a sparrow finding its haven where saffron grows wild, real identity is rooted in a place witnesses can actually see.
